expectations.text: Recommends dropping the reflexive per-folder and big aggregator barrels in favour of direct path imports
expectations.evidence: 'Delete the big src/components/index.ts'; 'Drop the per-folder index.ts re-exports too, by default' with direct path imports

expectations.text: Grounds it in agent indirection: the barrel hides where a symbol lives, so the agent hops or guesses the shape
expectations.evidence: 'agents are reluctant to look at other files... the answer to "where is Button defined?" is two hops away... or — more commonly — guesses'

expectations.text: Keeps a deliberate barrel only at a real public-API / package boundary (does NOT say delete all barrels)
expectations.evidence: 'Keep barrels only where there's a true package boundary with a deliberately curated public API (@acme/ui)'

expectations.text: Names at least one concrete secondary cost (circular imports, tree-shaking, or slow build/test startup)
expectations.evidence: Lists tree-shaking hazards, build/test-watch slowness, circular-dependency traps
